preconditions.expression: isinstance(S, str) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: S is a string consisting only of lowercase alphabets.
K is an integer such that 1 <= K <= length of S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) - K + 1) if len(set(S[i:i+K])) == K - 1)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the count of all substrings of length K in S that contain exactly K-1 distinct characters.
